bindings.caption: Conceptual Prepare the PVDF binder solution. Use the reported solution containing 0.2 g PVDF and an unspecified proper amount of N-methyl pyrrolidone. Preparation temperature/time and chronological order relative to solids mixing are unreported. No measured apparatus geometry is claimed.

bindings.caption: Conceptual Mix 2.2 g of PbS/CB solids at 10:1. Mix a combined 2.2 g of PbS powder and carbon black. Use the primary Sample C PbS:CB ratio 10:1 by weight explicitly defined in the Results. Individual charges are not reported and are not calculated here. No measured apparatus geometry is claimed.

bindings.caption: Conceptual Add mixed solids into the binder solution. Subsequently add the PbS/CB solids mixture into the PVDF solution.
